warning_source: Kobi Shabtai / Sigalit Bar-Zvi / Amir Cohen — serving Israel Police leadership
recipient: Senior state/security participants at Knesset State Control Committee hearing; PMO representative present
warning_summary: Police leadership warned that a nationwide multi-front outbreak would exceed current capacity. Bar-Zvi quantified a 106-sector scenario with only 63 sectors coverable, leaving 47 without police response, and major permanent/reserve personnel and equipment gaps; Cohen warned a ticking clock was leading toward the next events.
evidence_update: Official Knesset transcript recovered and reviewed. It directly documents the senior police participants, quantified capacity gap, senior-security receipt and a PMO representative at the hearing. Published in Notion as WARN-108 / High / contemporaneous / direct documented receipt. WARN-7 updated to distinguish the June 6 serving-police readiness warning from the June 9 former-chiefs letter.
gaps: No evidence establishes personal receipt by Netanyahu or a cabinet minister; Government-Level Receipt remains No. No specific post-hearing political decision attributable to this warning established.
